purpose: Reconstructed material art; not specimen scans. UV guides exported from existing procedural renderers.

Medium gray is the general surface, darker values are depressions/creases, lighter values are raised texture. Existing plate grooves dark, subtly raised concentric growth ridges lighter, broad plate centers neutral gray. No broad dome or edge lighting. Restrained contrast suitable for subtle physical surface relief, no labels, no border.

prompts.shell: Edit target: the supplied square tortoise shell UV texture, a flat 2D albedo guide. Produce a production game albedo texture, not an image of a tortoise. Keep square canvas, exact positions of all major plate boundary lines, same overall dark olive-brown and charcoal horn palette. Refine the crude scratchy drawing into a convincingly aged giant tortoise carapace surface: fine concentric growth ridges within each existing scute, shallow worn grooves at existing boundaries, muted horn striations, dusty worn edges, restrained irregular brown variation. Flatten the existing painted lighting gradient: use uniform diffuse illumination with no highlights, no cast shadows, no depth rendering. Texture fills the entire square, no background or labels, no extra plate boundaries and no cracks resembling shattered pottery. Fine natural surface detail should be clear at 1024px without high contrast outlines.
prompts.finch: Edit target: this exact 2048x1024 flat 2D finch UV material atlas. Keep the exact 4-column by 2-row grid of 512px square cells, no gutters, borders, text or labels. Do not draw a bird. Top row cells left to right: body wrap (dark back at both left/right edges, warm streaked brown flanks, pale buff belly vertical strip in center); head wrap (same dark edges/pale center, subtle streaking); inner wing dual top/bottom sheets (dark brown upper half, buff underside lower half, horizontal division exactly at midheight); outer wing same upper/lower division. Bottom row: coverts with short overlapping feather detail; single primary-feather texture with shaft across the cell horizontally and fine diagonal barbs; tail with exactly the existing six lengthwise feather divisions; last cell keep solid middle gray unused. Preserve all existing large color zones, shafts, feather boundaries and their coordinates. Add finely detailed natural muted female ground-finch plumage, layered soft contour feathers on body/head, precise fine barbs on flight feathers, subtle pale edges, irregular darker breast streaks. Keep the original subdued warm brown/buff palette, no bright plumage. Flat unlit albedo texture, no lighting, no embossed shadows, no objects, no transparency. This is an aligned UV atlas refinement, every cell must stay registered to the supplied guide.
prompts.skin: Generate a square seamless tiling PBR albedo texture of dry giant tortoise skin. Flat orthographic macro surface, warm neutral charcoal-gray with subtle dusty brown undertones. Irregular small polygonal leathery scales, fine creases between scales, broad shallow wrinkling blended through the field. Natural dense tortoise neck and leg skin, restrained scale contrast, no large repeated hexagonal reptile scales. Uniform flat diffuse illumination, no highlights, no baked shadows or perspective. Entire image filled with the skin material, no animal body, no eyes, no illustration border, no text. Texture scale: roughly 12 centimetres of skin across the square.
prompts.grass: Generate a square full-frame seamless game albedo texture of lengthwise grass-blade surface fibres. This is a flat UV material tile stretched along individual modeled grass blades, NOT a photograph of a clump of grass and NOT separate cutout blades. Entire canvas is filled with continuous fine vertical parallel plant fibres and subtle waxy longitudinal veins, mild irregular bleached and weathered streaks, tiny occasional dry scratches. Neutral pale straw-gray and desaturated light sage-gray palette so existing per-instance green or dry grass tint can multiply over it. Soft restrained medium-light values, no dark gaps, no silhouettes or background, no text, no cast shadows or highlights. Flat uniform illumination and no perspective. Vertical fibres run from top edge to bottom edge; opposite edges tile.
